data.name: Help.Overview.Description
data.value:
Created by konnokai.
Stream Assistant provides YouTube, Twitch, and TwitCasting stream notifications, plus YouTube membership verification and automatic role assignment.
Use {0} to see currently live members, {1} to view recording channels, and, on Boost Level 2 servers, {2} to update the server banner with a channel’s latest stream thumbnail. Use {3} for detailed command parameters.
After inviting the bot, create a dedicated notification channel and grant View Channel, Send Messages, and Embed Links. Full setup guide: https://konnokai.notion.site/a4fff40bd95c4bec9edca5b78cdd5d37
You can support Stream Assistant through {4} or {5}.

data.name: Help.CommandDetail.youtube.set-banner-change
data.value:
Use the latest video or stream thumbnail from a channel as the server banner. Leave the channel URL empty to disable this setting.
The bot needs Manage Server, and the server must be Boost Level 2. This feature depends on stream notifications, so the channel must be covered by a built-in source or the spider list.

data.name: Help.CommandDetail.youtube.add
data.value: Add YouTube stream notifications. Use `holo` for all Holo members. Use `2434` for Nijisanji JP, EN, and VR members; configure a channel spider first for other members. Use `other` to add stream notifications for selected channels outside those groups. Check the channel spider list for available channels.

data.name: Help.CommandDetail.youtube.remove
data.value: Remove YouTube stream notifications. Use `holo` to remove all Holo notifications. Use `2434` to remove all Nijisanji notifications. Use `other` to remove notifications for selected channels outside those groups. Use `all` to remove every YouTube stream notification.

data.name: Help.CommandDetail.youtube.set-message
data.value:
Set a notification message. Leave the message empty to clear custom text, or enter `-` to disable that notification type. Stream notifications must be configured first.
The bot needs Mention @everyone, @here, and All Roles because servers may ping a specific role.

data.name: Help.CommandDetail.twitch.set-message
data.value:
Set a notification message. Leave the message empty to clear custom text, or enter `-` to disable that notification type. Stream notifications must be configured first.
The bot needs Mention @everyone, @here, and All Roles because servers may ping a specific role.

data.name: Help.CommandDetail.twitcasting.set-message
